plugins.name: reason-grill
plugins.description: Deep argument interrogation — one command maps a claim, then attacks it from five adversarial angles (logic, evidence, counter, assumptions, integrity). A six-check calibration gate refuses to manufacture objections: on a sound argument, most angles return [SOUND]. Returns a calibrated verdict (HOLDS / HOLDS-IF-NARROWED / WOUNDED / DEFEATED).
